entry.title: SibtainOcn/android-debloatr

Scans every package, classifies OEM, carrier, Google and third-party bloatware by risk, and removes, disables or restores them. Works from a PC with PowerShell and a web GUI, or directly on the phone with a Bash script, no PC needed
